prompts.moderation-context: Use case: infographic-diagram. One landscape Chinese technical blog interior infographic, aspect about 1.805:1. Reference images define the approved series style: deep royal navy blue, clean white Chinese typography, cyan-to-green borders, very subtle luminous bottom ribbon and small feather emblem lower left. Use generous spacing, clear readable short labels, restrained flat cards. Mark with article ID and “示意图”. No fake screenshot, no evidence of passed tests, no checkmarks, no invented brand logos. Only show the specified content. Preserve exact identifiers, correct Chinese. Title “审核一条评论，需要哪些上下文”. Subtitle “M7-16 · 示意图”. Center “评论正文”. Four surrounding connected cards “评论者与时间”; “审核状态” / “reviewing / approved / rejected”; “articleId” / “关联文章”; “parentId” / “回复关系”. Bottom separate note “当前页面以文章 ID、父评论 ID 呈现关联信息”. Small final caption “ID 摘要不等于完整讨论树；回复提交也可能被拒绝”. No fabricated user content or article titles.
